working_definition: Olfactory receptor neurons of antennal coeloconic sensilla, annotated at sensillum-class level without naming receptors (Li et al. 2022 FCA, Manual Annotation).
searches_performed: antennal olfactory receptor neuron of coeloconic sensillum

best_match.fbbt_term: antennal olfactory receptor neuron of coeloconic sensillum
best_match.fbbt_definition: Odorant receptor neuron (ORN) whose dendrite transduces signals from a coeloconic antennal sensillum.

justification: The label names ORNs of coeloconic sensilla, which is exactly this FBbt class. No adult-specific variant exists; the term is already restricted to the antenna.
